item.title: Flooding as soon as it rains on the signal-controlled crossing and the cycling lane, 21st October
item.description:
This issue has been present for months if not years (I reported it before, to no avail). I hoped it would be sorted during the recent full update and resurfacing of Grosvenor rd, but apparently drainage was not included. This flooding makes the crossing impossible with a wheel chair or a rollator and difficult for all pedestrians as they have to skirt around the flood and there are two steps, not one, to get off the pavement.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Grosvenor Road, Pimlico, City of Westminster
